verses.text: Ha t'a sat in ch'at t'ak'walil, ix in wayichej in sayanek' winh xajanab'il wu'uj. Ix in sayek' winh, palta maj ilchaj winh wu'uj.
Slajwi chi', ix in k'e wa'an, ix in ek' in say winh t'a yol chonhab' chi'. Tzin sayanek' winh xajanab'il wuj t'a yoltak calle yet' t'a yoltak mercado. Ix in saynhej winh, palta maj ilchaj winh wu'uj.
Ix in k'anb'an t'a heb' policía tzek' stanhwej chonhab' chi': ¿Maj am eyil winh xajanab'il wu'uj? xin chi.

Kenanto wal tzin b'at t'a heb' winh chi', ix ilchaj winh xajanab'il wu'uj. Ix in och ketzketz t'a sk'ab' winh, majxo waktejel-laj winh. Ix wik'anb'at winh t'a spat ix in nun, t'a scuarto ix in nun chi' b'aj in alji, xchi ix. Syalan winh kelem.
Ex kob'estak aj Jerusalén, tzin tewi wal t'ayex to manh he pitzel swayanh ix xajanab'il wu'uj, munil ol el swayanh ix, xchi winh. Syalan heb' anima
¿Tas jun skot t'a tzinan lum chi', t'a skal jun topanh tab' skoti, haton t'a skal stab'il mirra yet' incienso yet' masanil makan suk'uk'i sjab' chonhb'il yuj heb' chonhwajum?
Haton b'aj sb'akhchajek' winhaj Salomón. Oyanoch 60 soldado t'a spatik, haton wal juntzanh heb' winh soldado te jelan t'a skal heb' israel.
Masanil juntzanh heb' winh chi', a k'e'en espada syak'lab'ej heb' winh, te jelan heb' winh t'a owal. Junjun heb' winh ayoch yespada t'a snanhal, tato ay tas ay smay tzek' t'ak'walil.
Ha winhaj Salomón ix sb'o jun b'aj sb'akhchajek' t'a te te' wach' ay t'a Líbano.

Ha yoyal, nab'a plata, haxo yijnub' yich, nab'a oro. Ha b'aj tz'em k'ojan winh, a anh púrpura ayoch t'ay. T'a yol chi' ayoch yelwanub' b'ob'il yuj heb' ix aj Jerusalén, yuj sch'oxani to xajan winh yuj heb' ix.
Ex ix aj Sion, elanhekb'at eyil winhaj rey Salomón. Ayk'e scorona winh, haton jun ix yak'k'e ix snun winh t'a sjolom t'a sk'uhal snupnaji, haton jun k'u b'aj ix te tzalaj sk'ol winh, xchi heb'.
